title: Use Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account - Gemini Notebook Help

facts.fact: Most users with a work or school Google Account have access to Gemini Notebook, though feature availability and data handling depend on their license.
facts.quote: Most users with a work or school Google Account have access to Gemini Notebook. Feature availability and how your data is handled depends on your license.

facts.fact: For Workspace and Workspace for Education users, Gemini Notebook is a core service, like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs.
facts.quote: Gemini Notebook is now a core service (like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs).

facts.fact: To get higher limits and additional features with a work or school account, the organization must upgrade to a Google Workspace plan that includes higher limits; users are told to contact their Workspace administrator.
facts.quote: your organization needs to upgrade to a Google Workspace plan that includes higher limits. Contact your Google Workspace administrator to request an upgraded license.

facts.fact: Under Standard Access, each user can have up to 100 notebooks.
Under Standard Access, each notebook can hold up to 50 sources.
Under Standard Access, users get 50 chats per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 3 Audio Overviews per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 3 Video Overviews per day.
Under Highest Level Access, users get 20 Cinematic Video Overviews per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 10 Reports per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 10 Flashcards, 10 Quizzes, and 10 Mind Maps per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 10 Deep Research uses per month.
Under Highest Level Access, users get 200 Deep Research uses per day.
Standard Access data protection: user data is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless the user provides feedback, and feedback may let Google review the full context of that interaction.
facts.quote: Your data is protected, and is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless you provide feedback.

facts.fact: Enterprise-grade security and privacy tiers state that uploaded files, chats and model outputs will not be reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.
facts.quote: Your uploaded files, chats and model outputs won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.

facts.fact: The page states that usage limits are subject to change.
